name: Dannosaki Lamia
source:
Daughter in a vampire family, she is [url=/c4986]Camilla[/url]'s older twin sister.

Lamia is a beautiful girl with an innocent personality.
She has the power to act, she is popular and friendly.

Hobbies: tracking the achievements of idols and admiring them, collecting small toy that are sold with food.
Her type of man: a guy who is great to be around.

[Roughly translated from [url=http://risusoftnosferatu.blog49.fc2.com/blog-entry-4.html]the official website[/url]]
